title: Villager Alert
description: Adds an alert for villagers appearing on pie chart.
body:
A quality of life mod that when enabled gives the user an audible and visual cue when a villager appears on the client's pie chart. With a villager "hmm" sound playing, and text displayed above the hotbar, so you don't have to keep your eyes on the pie chart while roaming around. 

_Note, this only works with the pie chart open and set to the entities section._
